components.content: # 👋 Hey there! Welcome to NextGen vPro Setup Commands!

Here you will find all the essential slash commands to configure and manage various features of NextGen vPro on your server. To use them, simply type `/` in your chat and select the command you need.

**Available Setup Slash Commands:**

`/addcategorie` Add a new apply category to this server.
`/addqeustion` Add one or more questions to an apply category.
`/cancelapply` Cancel your currently pending application.
`/cmdtimeout` Manage per-user command usage limits for this server.
`/jail-setup` Sets up the jail system for this server.
`/removebutton` Remove a self-role button mapping.
`/removecategorie` Remove an apply category from this server.
`/removequestion` Remove a question from an apply category.
`/resetapplies` Cancel every pending application in this server.
`/selfolressections` Manage self-role sections for this server.
`/selfrolebuttons` Add a button mapping to a self-role section.
`/selfroleslogs` Set the log channel for self-role actions.
`/sendapplypanel` Send the apply panel with category buttons into this channel.
`/sendsection` Send a configured self-role section to a channel.
`/setapply` Save the apply panel JSON template for this server.
`/setapplylogs` Set the channel used for application review logs.
`/setapplymanagers` Set one or more roles that can review applications.
`/tempchannel` Manage temporary voice channel triggers for this server.
`/updatesection` Update an existing self-role section.
`/verif-setup` Sets up the verification system for this server.
`/warn-setup` Sets up the warn system for this server.
